prompts.ko: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium Korean YouTube Shorts thumbnail / opening title card, portrait 9:16 (1080x1920 framing). Input image 1 is the actual collection painting featured in the video, use it prominently and faithfully as the artwork reference. Preserve exactly four people, original clothing colors, faces, poses, low board and game objects; preserve its delicate traditional Korean ink-and-color-on-paper aesthetic. Do not invent action, dice, extra sticks, people, or historical objects. Editorial museum poster meets compelling mobile thumbnail: warm ivory hanji paper, very large near-black Korean headline in upper third, one vermilion emphasis line, artwork generously occupying middle and lower area with all four faces visible. Art should look like a reproduction of the reference, not a cartoon redraw. Clean deliberate hierarchy, no collage boxes, no gradients, no noisy decorations, no border. Exact headline text across two lines: "조선의" then "보드게임". Small subtitle under headline: "윷놀이". Discreet bottom credit exact: "TJ KIM COLLECTION". Add small episode label exact: "01". Bold beautiful Korean typography highly legible at phone size, ample breathing room, keep all text at least 80px from horizontal edges and keep important content out of bottom 180px. Use warm ochre, muted jade and red from the painting. No watermark. Output only one finished portrait thumbnail.
